newsitem.title: USA: Northwestern Public to buy propane dealer for $120 mln.
newsitem.headline: Northwestern Public to buy propane dealer for $120 mln.

text.p: Northwestern Public Service said Monday that its Northwestern Growth Corp. unit agreed to acquire Empire Energy Corp., a retail distributor of propane, for $120 million.
Empire, based in Lebanon, Mo., has 168 retail branches in 10 states that service 132,000 customers, primarily in the southeastern United States.
In a separate deal, Northwestern Growth agreed to buy $10 million of CGI Holdings Inc.'s preferred stock. It has the option to acquire all of its common stock at a later date.

CGI is the parent of Coast Gas Inc., a retail propane distributor with 75,000 customers in seven western states. CGI, headquartered in Watsonville, Calif., also owns Coast Energy Group, a wholesaler of propane and other natural gas liquids.
